summary: Auto-detect next release version and downstream PLATE baseline; add epic-dir fragment support.
migration_impact: cut_release.py no longer requires a version argument -- it infers the next semver from the current baseline (flat files, versioned dirs, git tags) and from fragment metadata (breaking -> major, feature -> minor, else patch). render_release_migrations.py gains --auto-from to detect the from-version from a downstream repo. Fragments may now be placed in epic-NNN-slug/ directories in addition to unreleased/.
migration_guidance: 1. Pull the updated scripts/cut_release.py and scripts/render_release_migrations.py.
2. To cut a release without specifying a version, run: python scripts/cut_release.py
3. To override the bump type, run: python scripts/cut_release.py --version-type minor
4. To auto-detect the from-version for migration guidance, run: python scripts/render_release_migrations.py .agentic/releases --auto-from ../downstream-repo/.agentic/releases
5. Optionally organise epic-specific fragments in epic-NNN-slug/ directories alongside unreleased/.
agent_notes: When cutting a release, omit the version argument to let cut_release.py compute it automatically. The tool reads existing release files and git tags to find the latest baseline, then bumps based on fragment types. Supply --version-type or an explicit version if the inference is wrong. Use --auto-from in render_release_migrations.py to avoid hardcoding from-version values.
